decisionBasis.authority: Names, ownership, invariants and causal proof requirements are selected here. Native field/wire migration and runtime implementation remain separately verifiable work.

decisions.rationale: Source-wide exact revision/generation and published-batch ordering already own mutable replace/remove mappings. Explicitly absorb the earlier per-record-root role into ApplicationImportSource; preserve full verified mapping authority, immutable plans and publication gates.

Keep exact active operator identities/assignment episodes and acting-operator/last-operator checks in one atomic roster decision. Explicitly supersede the earlier per-user split; never reduce authority to a count or cap current membership.

Classification, reconciliation invalidation, complete-source proof and freeze seal are one conflict set on AuditPopulation. Immutable row/version bodies are values, not separate owners. Explicitly supersede the earlier row-root proposal; remove lifetime history coupling without splitting the seal.

Required exclusion is predecessor/successor competition within the same expectation lineage. Different lines may coexist, including different policies on one system. Explicitly supersede the older unspecified cross-line governor; adding a future cross-line ban is a separately reviewed product/design change with a precise predicate.
A professional assertion identity binding is permanent and non-recyclable. Exclude the stale release label.
Canonical package delivery is manifest Admitted then independent child Delivered. Exclude redundant Authorized; add no automated send authority.
The selected directed source/type/target UUID identity is the relationship uniqueness boundary. Exclude separate identity claim.
Relationship removal records lifecycle, never releases/recycles canonical tuple identity. Exclude separate identity release.

Recorded is the canonical authored preference decision, including accepted NoChange. ChangedAt advances only for actual value changes. Old Changed v1 remains read-only compatibility, with no replay conversion.

Ratify the selected artifact-first Pending202 protocol: stable caller CommandId, atomic local available-artifact reservation in Requested, artifact-qualified derived receiving grant, ordered source-use acquisition, encrypted original ticket before native issuance, terminal settlement/cancellation fencing, current original-actor scoped read, unchanged original expiry, and receiving-issued v2 preserving old artifact-issued v1 decoder.

Registered root subscription, logical prerequisite fact and continuation carrier are separate. Canonical continuation retains original admission reference and root-derived identity, but receiver must materialize/verify every required typed intermediate/terminal proof and exact immutable intent before effect or early replay where binding does not cover terms. A bare NativeFactReference never grants authority. Selected typed-source tables are corrected to this normative admission-plus-prerequisite model; installed carrier presence is not proof of conformance.

Retain exact occupied v1 effect UUID byte algorithm and each process frozen target-key/episode selection. Do not silently replace IDs. Explicitly version and domain-separate any new length-prefixed algorithm; new or ambiguous target/episode domains require a selected injective encoding and compatibility/fencing before use.

Atomically claim the exact approved version and actual approval tuple, including pinned NextExaminationId/NextTypeIIPlanId/NextPeriodId and dates. The private process coordinates existing readiness, examination, Type I baseline/auditor outcome/system description, TypeIIPlan review/approval and TypeIIPeriod start owners. It never synthesizes or owns their facts. A human-authored complete plan exhaustively maps every rollover item. Opening acceptance remains pending; actual ObservationPeriodStarted is terminal. Retire ProgramNextPeriodCreated from selected business emissions.
